newsitem.title: USA: AMBAC to buy assets of NY's Cadre Financial.
newsitem.headline: AMBAC to buy assets of NY's Cadre Financial.

text.p: AMBAC Inc said on Thursday that its financial services division has definitively agreed to acquire the assets of Cadre Financial Services Inc, a New York investment adviser and fund administrator, and Cadre Securities Inc, an affiliated broker-dealer.
The acquisition should close by year-end, the company said.
The company said it would reveal details of the acquisition upon closing.
Cadre is based in Lake Ronkonkoma, N.Y., and has assets under management and sales of fixed rate investments totalling $5 billion, including assets under administration of $2.7 billion, AMBAC said.
AMBAC is a New York City holding company for financial services and insurance affiliates.
